dog.description_text:
What’s better than a warm bowl of Broth? A lifetime of cuddles with this sweet girl! Broth is a 1-year-old mixed breed weighing around 15 pounds, and she’s serving up a whole lot of love! She’s incredibly sweet, loves meeting new people and dogs, and greets everyone with a happy, wagging tail. She’s also gentle with kids and walks beautifully on a loose leash, making her a wonderful little walking companion.

But Broth's favorite place to be is wherever her people are! She isn't the biggest fan of being left on her own just yet, as she'd much rather be spending time with her favorite people! She'll be a lovely match for someone looking for an affectionate, cuddly companion who can help her build confidence and independence.

Registered adopters interested in Broth can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you're not registered yet, do it today at hbrdogs.com!
